chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Abu Ayyub al-Khazzaz, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:

I looked at a parchment which Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) was looking at, so I read in it written: 'A son of a brother and a grandfather, the wealth between them is equal.' So I said to Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him): 'Indeed, those among us do not judge by this judgment, nor do they give anything to a son of a brother along with a grandfather.' So Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: 'But indeed, it was dictated by the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) from his mouth and written by Ali (peace be upon him) by his hand.'
ai.seo_question: What is the inheritance share of a grandfather versus a nephew in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi highlights the jurisprudential dispute between the community's prevailing practice, which often excluded the nephew in favor of the grandfather, and the authoritative ruling of Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him). He validates the equal distribution by tracing the text back to the Prophet’s dictation and Ali ibn Abi Talib’s handwriting, thereby establishing a strong chain of transmission (tawatur) for this specific inheritance rule. This underscores the Shia emphasis on the Ahl al-Bayt's role in preserving and interpreting the Sunnah against communal variations.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Abu Ayoub Al Khazaz, from Muhammad Bin Muslim who said,

‘I looked at a parchment which Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> made me look at, so I read (what was) written in it, a son of a brother (nephew), and a grandfather, the wealth (to be divided) between the two of them, equally. So I asked Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, ‘The ones in our presence are not judging by this judgement, nor are they making anything to be for a son of the brother’. So Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘But, it was dictated by Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> from his<sup>saww</sup> mouth and written by Ali<sup>asws</sup>, by his<sup>asws</sup> hand’.
en.sarwar: 5. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from abu Ayyub al-Khazzaz from Muhammad ibn Muslim who has narrated the following:

“I once looked in a book in which abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, was looking and I read therein that a son of a brother and grandfather share the legacy in equal ratios. I then said to abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al- Salam, ‘People around us do not judge with such judgment and they do not give to a son of a brother anything with a grandfather.’ Abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, said, ‘This is the dictation of the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, in the handwriting of Ali, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, from the mouth of the Messenger of Allah with his (Ali’s) hand.’”
